result.text: Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.

result.rule: When the description identifies a decision, conditional action, or stopping outcome between activities: Model every stated transition with sequence flows, including flows into and out of gateways, and connect each outcome to its next step or end.

When the description says an activity may occur in addition to the main sequence: Model the activity on an optional path, using a decision gateway to determine whether it occurs, and rejoin the main sequence afterward.

When the description says an occurrence may or may not happen and that its occurrence changes what the process does: Represent the possible occurrence with an appropriate BPMN event or decision gateway, and connect the path for handling it with sequence flows.

When the description states that one activity is required while an independent activity is performed only when a condition holds: Model the activities as branches of an inclusive gateway, with the required activity on an always-taken branch and the optional activity on a conditional branch; use an inclusive join before any subsequent activity that depends on their completion.
